Waley: “chiefly famous for his realistic pictures of birds and flowers”

Fenollosa: Huizong’s landscape strokes “foreshadow the incisiveness of Bayen” (Ma Yuan)

bio.text: Despite his political failures, Huizong was an accomplished painter, poet, calligrapher, and musician, as well as a major patron of the arts. His imperial collection included more than 6,000 paintings.
The Emperor himself came nearest to this high standard. Most imperial attempts at art are only flattered mediocrity ; but Kiso's work really rises to the heights.

bio.text: Hui Tsung must have been not only a skilful technician and prominent calligraphist, but also a really fine painter.
